J577-B0 best improves all five metrics with scene CIs excluding zero,including F1+0.0188673470 CI[0.0113148210,0.0276594104]. Final retains overall3 and band improvements but F1 is worse-0.1219339414 CI[-0.1408108220,-0.1054158982]. This endpoint reversal must be reported.

qualitative_incremental_best_cases.nyuv2_0246: J577 reduces broad wall/foreground depth error0.1637->0.1249 but F1 falls0.520->0.496;longer false ceiling/shelf segments and small foreground alignment changes persist. B0 still has lower depth error.
qualitative_incremental_best_cases.nyuv2_0080: J577 has substantially longer cyan shelf-post segments,F1 0.337->0.603 and AbsRel0.0678->0.0604. This favorable selected-best comparison is real,but the same run later loses most of those boundaries at final.

interpretation: One-seed J577 validation-selected best has stronger boundary F1 than matched J500/L577 and B0,but weaker boundary-band depth accuracy than J500/L577. Its stopping-final loses boundaries broadly despite nearly unchanged overall AbsRel. Retain both endpoints and all negative evidence;wait for the other two seeds before group conclusions.
